_README: Workspace + captured-mugshot pattern. Two-phase. Phase 1: build a minimal test with just navigation steps. Run scripts/capture_components.sh <test> <nav_step> to populate sys_atf_ui_component with the page's mugshots. Phase 2: update the test (action:'update') with full Custom UI steps that reference the captured mugshots inline as the 'component' input. The capture flow is the programmatic equivalent of Test Designer's 'Record Page Components' UI button.
name: Workspace form interaction — capture+replay example
description: Skeleton you fill in two phases. Phase 1: build as-is and run capture_components.sh. Phase 2: replace the <PASTE_*_LOCATOR_JSON_HERE> placeholders with what find_components.sh prints.

steps.user: <sys_user sys_id of the role you want — e.g., your Agent>

steps._comment: AFTER Phase 1 capture, fill component with the locator JSON that scripts/find_components.sh prints for the button you want to click. Paste it as a string (the JSON-quoted content of the locator field).

Set Component Values uses an encoded query format: <mugshot1>=<value1>^<mugshot2>=<value2>^ (trailing ^ required). Each mugshot is the full locator JSON of a setValue-capable component. Keep total length under ~5000 chars per step (glide_var size cap) — split into multiple steps if needed.

steps.table: <table where the save should have inserted/updated>
